title: Strikemode
summary: Strikemode is a spell used by Klaus to make the spell's target become stronger. The spell manifests as a red and yellow ball of goo-like energy that is launched at the intended target.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Jokoul used Strikemode on his Jokoul. This version had a violet aura instead of the usual red aura. [SAS-125]

Klaus used the spell to power up Brahe's offensive abilities. [The Bookshop Hunter]

Klaus later used his engineering abilities to improve the spell into Overmode. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

full_text:
Strikemode is a spell used by Klaus to make the spell's target become stronger. The spell manifests as a red and yellow ball of goo-like energy that is launched at the intended target. 

== History ==
Jokoul used Strikemode on his Jokoul. This version had a violet aura instead of the usual red aura. [SAS-125]

Klaus used the spell to power up Brahe's offensive abilities. [The Bookshop Hunter]

Klaus later used his engineering abilities to improve the spell into Overmode. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]
